title: GRAVEL 100% CINESE: COME VA questa ICAN Triaero Graro?

takeaways.text: Self-funded all-Chinese build (Italian, automatic captions): the frameset cost about US$900 (just over €800) and ICAN G40 wheels about US$730 in early 2026; the presenter offers a discount code.

A 44T chainring with 3 mm offset rubbed and marked the frame on the first ride (a protector limited damage); he switched to a 42T zero-offset ring with a small spacer and notes ICAN does not list a 44T maximum.
He ran 45 mm tires, which he says is the frame's maximum; at 178 cm he rides a size M with a 110 mm stem.

After about two months as his main bike on road, fast gravel, cross-country trails and mud: stiff, efficient and comfortable, road-like on tarmac and agile off-road; his finished build weighed about 8.2 kg.

disclosure: The description includes an ICAN affiliate referral link and other shop affiliate links.
summary: Italian review after two months on an all-Chinese Graro build with ICAN G40 wheels at about 8.2 kg, covering frame, wheels, components and mixed-terrain riding. The build and costs are the creator's own, not the catalog estimate.
